explain.title: What this means
explain.none: The explanation hasn't been written in this language yet.
explain.source_note: Test information from MedlinePlus, US National Library of Medicine (public domain).
explain.disclaimer: This explanation helps you understand your results. It is not a diagnosis. Talk to your doctor about what they mean for you.
explain.template_note: This explanation is built from your values only.
explain.reason_no_consent: Nabz can write a fuller explanation with an AI service. It sends only your test values, age group and sex: no name, no dates, nothing else from your report.
explain.reason_validation: A fuller explanation was written, but it didn't pass Nabz's safety checks, so this safer one is shown.
explain.reason_provider_error: The AI service didn't respond, so this explanation is built from your values only.
explain.reason_critical: Because a result is beyond a critical limit, Nabz shows only this fixed explanation.
explain.voice_consent: Listening sends the explanation's text (no name or report details) to ElevenLabs to turn it into speech.
explain.audio_failed: The audio couldn't be made just now. Try again later.
explain.by_model: Written by an AI service and checked by Nabz before you see it.

legal.privacy_intro: What Nabz collects, why, where it goes, and how to delete it.
legal.privacy_collect: Your email address and a hashed password. For each person you add: a name, and if you give them, sex, date of birth and relationship to you. The lab reports you upload, the values read from them, your corrections, and the explanations Nabz writes.
legal.privacy_why: Only to show you your own results, explain them, and track them over time. Nothing is sold, shared for advertising or used for research unless you turn research on.
legal.privacy_where: On the Nabz server, in a PostgreSQL database and a private file store. Report files are never served from a public address.
legal.privacy_ai:
Only if you allow it for a person:
• Explanations: the test names and values, an age group and sex go to Groq. Never a name, a date or the report image.
• Listening: the explanation text goes to ElevenLabs to be read aloud.
Both can be turned off at any time on the person's page.
legal.privacy_keep: Until you delete it. Deleting a report, a person or your account removes the files, the values and everything derived from them. A minimal audit entry, without health data, remains.
legal.privacy_rights: Download everything for a person (Settings → Your family's data), correct any value, withdraw consent, and delete. These follow India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
legal.privacy_contact: Write to the Nabz team through the college project contact.
legal.safety_title: What Nabz is and is not
legal.safety_intro: Nabz helps you understand a lab report and prepare for your doctor. It does not diagnose.
legal.safety_is: An explainer. It reads the values a qualified lab has already produced, compares them with the lab's ranges, shows how they changed over time, and explains in plain words what each test measures.
legal.safety_is_not: It is not a doctor. It doesn't name diseases, suggest medicines or doses, or tell you that you are healthy. It is not for emergencies.
legal.safety_checks: You confirm every value first. The explanation uses only trusted health information (MedlinePlus). Every number is checked against your values, and wording that diagnoses or advises treatment is blocked. If a check fails, Nabz shows a simpler, fixed explanation instead.
legal.safety_critical: If a result is beyond a critical limit, Nabz shows only a fixed message asking you to contact a doctor today. If you feel very unwell, go to the nearest emergency department.
legal.safety_doctor: Only a doctor who knows you can say what your results mean for you. Use Nabz's questions to make the most of the visit.
